```yaml
name: Approve Workflows

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Check if contributor is first-time
        id: check-contributor
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get the PR author
          PR_AUTHOR=$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json author --jq '.author.login')
          
          # Count PRs by this author (excluding the current one)
          PR_COUNT=$(gh pr list --author "$PR_AUTHOR" --state all --json number --jq 'length')
          
          # If PR count is 1, it's likely their first PR (current one)
          if [ "$PR_COUNT" -le 1 ]; then
            echo "is_first_time=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_first_time=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check for ok-to-test label
        id: check-label
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ok-to-test') }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "has_ok_to_test=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_ok_to_test=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Approve workflows
        if: steps.check-contributor.outputs.is_first_time == 'false' || steps.check-label.outputs.has_ok_to_test == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Get pending workflow runs for this PR
          RUNS=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.event == "pull_request" and .status == "queued") | .id')
          
          for RUN_ID in $RUNS; do
            echo "Approving workflow run $RUN_ID"
            gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/approve --method POST
          done
```
